records.reason: The secondary weapon gains the primary weapon's fundamental runes while both are wielded. The engine HAS this lane (inv.copyRunesFrom + effectiveWeaponRunes in derive.ts) but it is gated behind DOUBLING_RINGS, a hardcoded set of two ids, so the blazons deliver nothing.

fix.note: Extend derive.ts DOUBLING_RINGS / investedDoublingRings to recognise blazons-of-shared-power (invested, worn) so a weapon marked copyRunesFrom picks up the primary's FUNDAMENTAL runes only. Unlike the rings there is no same-group requirement, and the secondary's own runes are suppressed rather than max'd. No item field can express this.

records.reason: As the base blazons, plus property runes are copied too (and the secondary's own runes are suppressed entirely). Nothing reads it — the rune-copy path only fires for doubling-rings/doubling-rings-greater.

fix.note: Same lane as blazons-of-shared-power: teach investedDoublingRings/effectiveWeaponRunes about blazons-of-shared-power-greater, copying fundamental AND property runes, suppressing the secondary's own runes, with an invest-time toggle for fundamental-only. Not expressible as an item field.

A 10-minute alchemical activity that rewrites another consumable's splash into persistent damage. Crafting/downtime apparatus — the changed bomb is resolved when it is thrown.

"Bombs fired with a bomb launcher have a range increment of 60 feet" — that overrides the range increment shown on every bomb Strike the owner makes, and no field on an item can reach another item's range.

fix.note: Needs a range-override lane: while a bomb-launcher is held in two hands, thrown-bomb Strikes should show range 60 instead of the bomb's own 20. There is no item field for modifying another item's range increment, and no situational kind covers range.

A raw material entry: Hardness/HP/BT tables for objects made of bone. Object statistics the GM uses, not anything on a character sheet.

A 1-hour activation whose whole content is a GM-adjudicated Recall Knowledge result and a narrative cost (a lost memory, a shortened lifespan); its only mechanical price is the Drained 2 condition, which the sheet already tracks as a condition.

The rune is registered in core.runes but with no `damage` entry, so its per-Strike riders (1d4 fire always, plus 1d4 spirit vs fiends and 1d4 vitality vs undead) never reach a Strike. derive.ts reads db.runes[p].damage, which is populated only from the hardcoded RUNE_DAMAGE table in scripts/import-core.mjs.

fix.note: Add brilliant to RUNE_DAMAGE in scripts/import-core.mjs — but the shape must first grow a target-conditional rider: 1d4 fire on every successful Strike, +1d4 spirit only against fiends, +1d4 vitality only against undead. The existing RuneDamage shape carries a single unconditional type, so this cannot be expressed today. (Crit-blind and the Shine Bright! counteract activation need nothing.)

records.reason: Same as brilliant: registered as a weapon property rune with no `damage`, so the 1d4 fire / 1d4 spirit vs fiends / 1d4 vitality vs undead riders are inert. The greater version additionally ignores the target's resistances to those three types, which has no lane at all.

fix.note: Same RUNE_DAMAGE gap as brilliant, plus a resistance-bypass flag (damage from this weapon ignores fire, spirit and vitality resistance). Neither is expressible with the current rune-damage shape.

records.reason: A consumable catalyst added to a Shield casting; its whole effect is persistent bleed on creatures ADJACENT TO YOU that fail a Reflex save when you Shield Block. Target-side and consumed in the moment.

It automatically absorbs magic missiles targeting the wearer, with a hard stock of 30 before it melts — an owner-side defensive resource with a count. The record carries no counter, so nothing tracks how many are left (and the text says a found brooch may already be partly spent).
Its content is a flat check to avoid sinking whose DC the GM sets and adjusts for weather and water conditions. No standing modifier on the wearer.
